fp_rate.reason: The paper only gives the FP rate (0.001) as a fixed simulation setting, not an FP rate estimated or reported for BnpC's own calls; no inferred FP rate is printed.

fn_rate.reason: The paper only gives the FN rate (0.3) as a fixed simulation setting, not an FN rate estimated or reported for BnpC's own calls; no inferred FN rate is printed.

crp_alpha.reason: The concentration parameter alpha0 is said to be learned (Escobar and West) but no value is reported in the text.

n_clusters.reason: No total number of clones inferred by BnpC on a named data set is stated; only qualitative statements or per-tissue counts (three clones in tissue C2) are given.

psrf.reason: The Gelman-Rubin diagnostic is mentioned as implemented but no PSRF value is reported in the text.
